$comment: Secrets a project's .workpilot/.env may hold. 'encrypted': the Python backend only reads them from the environment the main process builds from that file, so they are stored enc: (safeStorage). 'readable': the backend reads them from the file itself, in processes started without the project's environment, so they stay in clear (0600) and the UI names them. See docs/architecture/secrets-at-rest.md; tests/test_project_env_secrets.py holds the backend to it.
